pages.text: Rune Anchors are the first world spell carrier.$(br2)Rune Chalk carries a chosen anchor theorem. Use the chalk in the air to change the theorem, then use it on an anchor to inscribe that construction.

pages.title: Controls
pages.text: $(li)Chalk in air: change theorem.$(li)Chalk tooltip: shows the chosen theorem.$(li)Chalk on anchor: inscribe.$(li)Sneak-use chalk on anchor: erase inscription.$(li)Empty hand: enact the proof.$(li)Sneak-use empty hand: inspect the theorem.

pages.title: Sacrifice Pulse
pages.text: Sacrifice Pulse consumes one amethyst sacrifice dropped within 2.5 blocks of the anchor, then plays the same marker effect.$(br2)The built-in selector accepts $(item)minecraft:amethyst_shard$() plus common amethyst gem tags when a pack provides them.

pages.title: Offering Spark
pages.text: Offering Spark consumes the same amethyst shard, then conjures one $(item)minecraft:glowstone_dust$() at the anchor.$(br2)This is a tiny first drop rune: fixed item, fixed count, and fully server-side.

pages.title: Warding Pulse
pages.text: Warding Pulse consumes one amethyst sacrifice, then pushes nearby non-player living entities away from the anchor.$(br2)It is intentionally harmless: no damage, no explosions, and players are ignored.

pages.title: Kinetic Transducer
pages.text: This theorem observes entities within eight blocks, takes the mean magnitude of their velocities, and converts it into redstone power from 0 to 15.$(br2)The measurement is a snapshot: enacting the proof holds that result for ten seconds. Enact it again to sample anew.
